note: FLEX (Flame Extinguishment Experiment, PSI-69): one row per `_TestSheet.txt` file of the PSI listing of 2026-11-15. 272 listed, 271 parsed, 1 excluded. Excluded: FLEX-128_TestSheet.txt (same bytes as FLEX-127_TestSheet.txt, the test its title line names). Also: the sheet of FLEX-237 is titled FLEX-238; its test_id is that of its file name; FLEX-245 has the line `Dext (mm) ~ 2.17`, without `=`, which is not read as a value; FLEX-184, FLEX-188, FLEX-190, FLEX-191 and FLEX-193 give `Friday, December 31, 0002` as test date, a year outside 2009 to 2011: test_date is null there. Values are those of the sheets, read by label: nothing is filtered or fitted, and what a sheet does not give is null.

columns.name: test_id
columns.description: FLEX test identifier, from the name of its test sheet file

columns.name: cir_test_number
columns.description: CIR test number, as the sheet gives it

columns.name: test_date
columns.description: Test date (YYYY-MM-DD); null if the sheet gives none, or one in a year outside 2009 to 2011

columns.name: fuel
columns.description: Fuel, as the sheet names it

columns.name: support
columns.description: Droplet support: fiber if the sheet says `Fiber: Yes`, free (free droplet) if it says `Fiber: No`

columns.name: d_ext
columns.description: Droplet extinction diameter; null means the sheet does not report it, and 0 is kept as the sheet gives it

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: PSI key of the test sheet the row was read from
